mapper.sql: t.* , qc_task.task_no AS source_qc_task_no , prod_order.order_no AS prod_order_no , work_order.work_order_no AS work_order_no , op_task.task_no AS op_task_no , op_task.op_name AS op_name

FROM mes_rework t LEFT JOIN mes_qc_task qc_task ON qc_task.id = t.source_qc_task_id AND qc_task.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_prod_order prod_order ON prod_order.id = t.prod_order_id AND prod_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_work_order work_order ON work_order.id = t.work_order_id AND work_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_op_task op_task ON op_task.id = t.op_task_id AND op_task.deleted = 0
